children: Quince Therapeutics' President Charles Ryan departed effective September 8, 2026, under a Separation Agreement providing a $1,014,489.04 lump-sum severance payment.
As previously agreed between the Company and Mr. Ryan
Not disclosed beyond his role as President

Lump-sum $1,014,489.04 payable within 30 days after Separation Agreement effective date; includes 18 months base salary, 150% of 2026 target bonus pro‑rated to Sept 8, 2026, and 18 months COBRA premiums, subject to release and non-revocation
